act.name: Public Liability Insurance Act, 1991
act.source_authority: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change, Government of India
act.description: Central law providing immediate no-fault relief for persons affected by accidents involving hazardous substances.

sections.title: Liability to give relief in certain cases on principle of no fault.
sections.text: Section 3 concerns no-fault relief for death, injury or property damage from a hazardous-substance accident; consult the linked official text for the complete provision.
sections.plain_language_summary: Specified victims of hazardous-substance accidents may claim immediate statutory relief without proving wrongful act, neglect or default.
